source.author: stat
source.text: conticuere chori, dapibus ludoque licenti fit modus et primae decrescunt murmura noctis, cum consanguinei mixtus caligine Leti rore madens Stygio morituram amplectitur urbem Somnus et implacido fundit gravia otia cornu secernitque viros, vigilant nuptaeque nurusque in scelus, atque hilares acuunt fera tela Sorores, invasere nefas, cuncto sua regnat Erinys pectore, non aliter Scythicos armenta per agros Hyrcanae elausere leae, quas exigit ortu prima fames, a vidique implorant ubera nati.
source.text_original: conticuere chori, dapibus ludoque licenti / fit modus et primae decrescunt murmura noctis, / cum consanguinei mixtus caligine Leti / rore madens Stygio morituram amplectitur urbem / Somnus et implacido fundit gravia otia cornu / secernitque viros, vigilant nuptaeque nurusque / in scelus, atque hilares acuunt fera tela Sorores, / invasere nefas, cuncto sua regnat Erinys / pectore, non aliter Scythicos armenta per agros / Hyrcanae elausere leae, quas exigit ortu / prima fames, a vidique implorant ubera nati.
source.text_english: The choirs fell silent; there was an end to feasting and to unrestrained play, and the murmurs of the first night diminished, when Sleep, kinsman of Death, drenched with Stygian dew, with mist mingled about him, embraces the city that is to die and pours out heavy rest from his unpitying horn, and separates the men; the wives and daughters-in-law keep watch for crime, and the Sisters, eager, sharpen their savage weapons. Wickedness has taken hold; Erinys reigns in every breast. Not otherwise, on the Scythian plains, the Hyrcanian lionesses have enclosed the herds, whom hunger first drives from birth, and the newborn, seeing them, implore their teats.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Iamque mero ludoque modus, positique quietis conticuere toris; solus quibus ordine fusis impatiens somni ductor manet.
reuse.text_original: Iamque mero ludoque modus, positique quietis / conticuere toris; solus quibus ordine fusis / impatiens somni ductor manet.
reuse.text_english: And now there was a stop to wine and sport, and those laid upon their couches for rest had fallen silent; only the leader remained, stretched out in order among them, unable to sleep.
